title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Crispy flour tortillas filled with cumin-spiced black beans, cheddar and scallions.
instructions: Mash about half the beans with cumin; fold in the remaining whole beans and scallions.
Spread bean mixture on half of each tortilla, top with cheddar, and fold closed.
Heat a little oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook each folded tortilla for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
